useCase: Detection of local manipulación (cut-paste, editing), AI inpainting, and regions with inconsistent compression history. Widely used in digital análisis forense de imágenes and content verification.
mechanism:
The ELA análisis process:

1. **Re-compression**: The image is re-saved at a fixed calidad JPEG level (typically 95%).

2. **Difference calculation**: Pixel-by-pixel comparison entre the original and re-compressed image, creating an absolute difference map.

3. **Error patrón análisis**: In an unmodified JPEG, the entire image has undergone the same compression, so error levels are relatively uniform. Manipulated or generado por IA regions show different error levels because they've undergone different compression histories.

4. **Uniformity assessment**: AI images typically show abnormally uniform error levels a través de the entire image because all pixels were generated, not captured.
accuracy: Alta - 88-94% for JPEG images. Effectiveness significantly decreases for PNG images or multiply-compressed JPEGs.
name: Anomalía de Nivel de Error Visual (ELA)
parameters:
Re-compression quality: 95%, Color space: YCbCr, DCT block size: 8x8
Analysis: absolute pixel difference, regional error level varianza
Umbral: adaptativo based on global error distribución
description: Análisis de Nivel de Error resaves an image at a known calidad JPEG and compares the error levels entre the original and re-compressed version. generado por IA images show abnormally uniform error patrones, while authentic photos exhibit varying artefactos de compresión en diferentes regiones.

references.title: Krawetz, N. (2007). A Picture's Worth: Digital Image Analysis and Forensics. Hacker Factor.
Krawetz, N. (2012). A Picture's Worth — More on ELA. Black Hat USA.
Farid, H. (2009). Image Forgery Detection. IEEE Signal Processing Magazine.
Popescu, A.C. & Farid, H. (2005). Exposing Digital Forgeries by Detecting Traces of Resampling. IEEE TSP.

strengths:
• Intuitive and easy to understand for non-experts
• Good detección of local manipulación and empalme
• Low computational cost, fast análisis
• Particularly effective with single-compression JPEGs
limitations:
• Only effective for JPEG images, not applicable to PNG/WebP
• Multiple compresión JPEGs introduce noise into results
• Resized or cropped images may produce falsos positivos
• Cannot distinguish AI from heavily post-processed real images
